rows.note: Use this for household or utility fuel gas, including gas supplied to homes.

example.english: There’s no gas in the kitchen, so I can’t cook.
example.jyutping: cyu4 fong2 mou5 mui4 hei3 zyu2 m4 dou2 faan6

rows.note: Use this for gasoline or petrol for vehicles.

example.english: This car needs gas before it can go.
example.traditional: 呢架車要入汽油先行得。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaa3 ce1 jiu3 jap6 hei3 jau4 sin1 haang4 dak1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for gas as a state of matter or substance.

example.english: Oxygen is a type of gas.
example.jyutping: joeng5 hei3 hai6 jat1 zung2 hei3 tai2

rows.note: Use this for digestive gas or trapped gas in the stomach and intestines.

example.english: I get a belly full of gas after eating beans.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 jyun4 dau6 seng4 tou5 wai6 hei3
